name: chef_agent
description: Kitchen fulfillment agent. Verifies the Front-of-House agent's employee credential, calls the Kitchen API to prepare the order, and negotiates ingredient substitutions when a resource is unavailable. Never talks to the customer or the Front-of-House agent's caller directly.

extensions.description: Requires a Verifiable Presentation of the caller's employee credential before processing requests.

skills.name: prepare_order
skills.description: Accept a finalized order from the Front-of-House agent, prepare it via the Kitchen API, and propose an ingredient substitution if a required ingredient is unavailable.
